mapper.select: SELECT ai_route_id AS aiRouteId, user_id AS userId, conversation_id AS conversationId, ai_route_title AS aiRouteTitle, ai_route_days AS aiRouteDays, ai_route_region AS aiRouteRegion, ai_route_startdate AS aiRouteStartDate, ai_route_enddate AS aiRouteEndDate, ai_route_created AS aiRouteCreated, weather_consideration AS weatherConsideration FROM tblAiRoute WHERE ai_route_id = #{aiRouteId}

SELECT s.ai_route_stop_id AS aiRouteStopId, s.ai_route_id AS aiRouteId, s.ai_route_day AS aiRouteDay, s.ai_route_stop_order AS aiRouteStopOrder, s.ai_route_lat AS aiRouteLat, s.ai_route_long AS aiRouteLong, s.ai_route_description AS aiRouteDescription, s.activity_code AS activityCode, s.duration_in_minutes AS durationInMinutes, s.restaurant_category AS restaurantCategory, s.walking_distance_km AS walkingDistanceKm, s.walking_steps_count AS walkingStepsCount, s.transportation_mode AS transportationMode, h.healthcare_id AS healthcareId, h.healthcare_distance_km AS healthcareDistanceKm, h.healthcare_steps_count AS healthcareStepsCount, h.healthcare_calories_burned AS healthcareCaloriesBurned FROM tblAiRouteStop s LEFT JOIN tblHealthCareLog h ON s.ai_route_stop_id = h.ai_route_stop_id WHERE s.ai_route_id = #{aiRouteId} ORDER BY s.ai_route_day, s.ai_route_stop_order

SELECT ai_route_stop_id AS aiRouteStopId, ai_route_id AS aiRouteId, ai_route_day AS aiRouteDay, ai_route_stop_order AS aiRouteStopOrder, ai_route_lat AS aiRouteLat, ai_route_long AS aiRouteLong, ai_route_description AS aiRouteDescription, activity_code AS activityCode, duration_in_minutes AS durationInMinutes, restaurant_category AS restaurantCategory, walking_distance_km AS walkingDistanceKm, walking_steps_count AS walkingStepsCount, transportation_mode AS transportationMode FROM tblAiRouteStop WHERE ai_route_stop_id = #{aiRouteStopId}
